summary: Created Redux store with smsSlice for managing SMS messages. Installed @reduxjs/toolkit and react-redux. Defined message data model with recipientPhone, messageContent, scheduledTime, status (scheduled/sent/failed), retryCount, and timestamps. Added reducers for addMessage, updateMessageStatus, removeMessage, setLoading, and setError. Created selector functions for filtering messages by status and ID. Added JSDoc type definitions in sms.types.js.
